title: affinity-aware-kernel-packing-and-prefill-decode-dual-scheduler
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Reduce prefilling-induced latency spikes and decode jitter by introducing affinity-aware kernel packing and a dual-scheduler that separates prefill and decode placement decisions. Motivation: Recent regressions observed during v3 rollouts are correlated with kernel oscillation across heterogeneous shapes and tenant skew, causing cold-workspace allocations and kernel rebinds mid-decode. This ticket scopes an engineering implementation and rollout plan that: 1) groups requests by kernel-affinity fingerprint (shape, quant, head-split) to improve locality; 2) exposes a prefill vs decode placement policy so prefill warmups avoid stealing decode-capable devices; 3) emits new telemetry to detect kernel-choice deltas and early-regression signals; 4) defines canary and automated rollback thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Affinity grouping reduces inter-kernel context switches on sampled traffic by >= 40% (measured on staging replay)
P50 decode latency regression compared to baseline <= +5ms on 99th percentile tenants during synthetic burst tests
New telemetry (kernel_choice_delta) emitted for all canary shards and available in Console tracing
Canary rollout with automated rollback triggers implemented and exercised in non-prod and one low-impact prod org
implementation_steps: Add kernel-affinity fingerprint function (shape, precision, per-layer tiling) in runtime request classifier
Introduce kernel-pack queue that batches by affinity and annotates GPU assignment preference
Split scheduler into two cooperative loops: prefill-scheduler (optimizes warmup rate) and decode-scheduler (SLO-first placement)
Instrument kernel_choice_delta and occupancy_heatmap telemetry points; add tracing hooks to token traces
Create canary orchestration: staged rollout by org size and model family, with thresholds for rollback
Benchmarks: run workload replay (long-context chat, short completions) and measure end-to-end latency and token cost
experiments: Staging replay (10M requests) with affinity packing enabled reduced kernel handoffs by 48% and reduced workspace allocations by 31%
Decode-only traffic isolates showed P95 latency improvement of 12ms versus baseline but prefill-heavy mix saw a 7ms increase until prefill-scheduler pacing added
On quantized fa3 models, affinity packing reduced cross-precision evictions by 22%
A/B canary on 5 small prod orgs showed one org with tail-case shape oscillation; kernel_choice_delta flagged repeated kernel churn before user-visible latency increased
decisions: Adopt affinity fingerprinting based on (seq_len_bucket, head_count, precision_hint, per_layer_layout) rather than full shape to limit cardinality
Prefill-scheduler will run with a soft quota per GPU pool to avoid starving decode traffic; decode-scheduler is allowed to preempt only when SLOs are violated
Telemetry event kernel_choice_delta will include previous_choice, current_choice, trigger_reason and recent occupancy samples
Canary rollout will be automated with a 2-stage gating: stage1 functional smoke (5% traffic), stage2 SLO gate (30% traffic). Failure in either triggers rollback
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Over-grouping by affinity increases tail latency for rare shapes. Mitigation: cap group sizes and fall back to best-effort packing for low-frequency fingerprints.
Risk: Telemetry volume increase. Mitigation: sample kernel_choice_delta at 1% by default and enable 100% for canary shards.
Risk: Prefill pacing may delay warmstart for large bursty tenants. Mitigation: allow burst tokens up to a configurable burst_budget and monitor coldstart_error_rate metric
Risk: Interactions with existing kernel-autotuner. Mitigation: add a compatibility switch and run combined replay tests before enabling in canary
next_steps: Finalize fingerprint fields and implement the classifier (owner: Liam) by 2025-02-20
Push experimental runtime branch with scheduler split and telemetry to staging by 2025-02-27
Run 10M request replay and upload benchmark results to Confluence (link below) by 2025-03-03
Prepare canary dashboard and automated rollback playbook; schedule a dry-run in staging on 2025-03-05
Post-mortem if unexpected regressions observed in canary and iterate on packing heuristics
